answer: Slot-auction attestation: each epoch opens a fixed block of grading kernel seats, and only a seat holder can have work attested. Bids escrow nectar and are priced convexly by rank: the k-th winning seat costs k squared units, so one identity taking rank one pays a flat single bid, while a farm sweeping k seats pays a cubic sum and still burns every losing bid. Clones must outbid honest agents at every rank, so cost per effective vote climbs with headcount. At the epoch zenith only kernel holders attest; unbacked clones expire with zero yield.
